MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper felt useful because it would help me measure screw diameters and match washers to shafts when using my assortment kits.",
    "That measuring tool connected to a practical next step in using my recent hardware purchases. It was the only item I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament does not follow from buying fasteners and magnetic hooks; I have no current printing project, regardless of filament color or material.",
    "Wire connectors, heat shrink tubing and battery lugs require electrical tasks I am not currently doing. Owning screws does not make those supplies useful to me.",
    "The feeler gauge measures gaps rather than the hardware dimensions I need, and the large glue refill kit assumes an adhesive project I do not have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or DIY supply.",
    "The repeated filament suggestions assume a specific hobby that my recent purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point toward fastening and hanging tasks, so usefulness for those tasks matters more than a broad connection to tools.",
    "I rarely interact without a clear need. A plausible use with items I already bought, like measuring my fasteners, gives me a reason to choose something."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The caliper fits my current hardware needs, but most suggestions stretch those needs into unrelated workshop projects."
}
